description: Rust High-Performance Execution Engine - A Rust binary/HTTP service for command validation, input sanitization, streaming JSON output parsing, and execution with proper timeout/signal handling. Communicates via HTTP JSON API.
steps: Create services/executor/Cargo.toml with dependencies: tokio, axum (HTTP), serde/serde_json, regex, thiserror, tracing/tracing-subscriber
Create services/executor/src/models.rs - Shared types: ExecutionRequest, ExecutionResult, ValidationResult, CommandConfig, HealthResponse
Create services/executor/src/validator.rs - Command validation with whitelist of allowed commands, pattern matching against dangerous patterns (shell injection, path traversal, etc)
Create services/executor/src/sanitizer.rs - Input sanitization: strip shell metacharacters, normalize paths, validate URL formats, detect and block injection attempts

Create services/executor/src/executor.rs - Command execution with tokio: timeout management via tokio::time::timeout, proper signal handling with tokio::signal, capture stdout/stderr, streaming line-by-line output
Create services/executor/src/parser.rs - JSON line parser: process streaming output line by line, extract structured findings from JSON lines, handle malformed input gracefully

Create services/executor/src/main.rs - Entry point: axum HTTP server on port 7003 with routes POST /execute (validate and run), POST /validate (validation only), POST /sanitize (sanitize input), GET /health

Create services/executor/tests/integration_test.rs - Integration tests: command validation accepts/rejects correctly, sanitizer strips dangerous chars, executor handles timeouts, parser extracts findings from JSON lines
acceptance_criteria: Running 'cd services/executor && cargo build' compiles without errors
Running 'cd services/executor && cargo test' passes all tests
Validator correctly rejects commands containing shell injection patterns
Sanitizer removes dangerous characters while preserving valid input
Parser correctly extracts structured data from JSON line streams
Timeout handling properly terminates long-running executions
